description: Change the listing automation of a one-item-per-listing marketplace (Vinted). Send only the fields to change; the rest stay as saved. Changing when it lists (relistTiming, windows, maxPerDay) and turning a behaviour off work with the settings scope alone; turning relistAfterSale, relistOnRestock or the refresh ON also needs a dry run first (preview_listing_automation) and the workspace owner's switch for AI listing automation in Settings → Integrations → Connect AI, which is off by default. Once on, the CRM creates (and, for a refresh, takes down) listings on the live marketplace account by itself, only for products whose stock it counts. It never turns on the connection's own publishing: when that is off, the result carries the warning publishing_not_armed and nothing is sent until the owner turns it on. Turning a behaviour off cancels its waiting listings. Pass expectedVersion from get_listing_automation to avoid overwriting a change made meanwhile. Returns the saved settings, what was turned on and off, cancelled and warnings. Echoes the workspace.

expectedVersion.description: The settings version get_listing_automation returned. When given, the change is refused if someone saved meanwhile, instead of overwriting their change.

maxPerDay.description: At most this many new listings a day, spread evenly over the day's publishing windows; null removes the limit. Omit to keep it.

platform.description: The marketplace whose listing automation this is. Only vinted has one today.

refreshAfterDays.description: Take down and list again a listing that has not sold for this many days (14, 30 or 60), so it shows near the top again; null turns it off. It loses the listing's likes and views. Omit to keep it.

relistAfterSale.description: After a sale, list the next unit of the same product as a new listing. Only products whose stock the CRM counts. Omit to keep it.

relistOnRestock.description: List a product again once stock arrives, after it sold out or was taken down for having none. Listings a person took down stay down. Omit to keep it.

relistTiming.description: When a sold listing goes up again: instant (seconds after the sale's order is in the CRM), next_run (the automation's next pass, within 10 minutes — the default), after_1h, after_6h or after_24h. Omit to keep it.

windows.description: Publishing windows in the workspace time zone: new listings go up only inside them, e.g. [{"weekday":5,"from":"18:00","to":"22:00"}] for Friday evening (weekday 1 = Monday, times on 10-minute steps, "to" may be "24:00"). An empty list means any time. Omit to keep them.
